werc-1992.notes: The archives name the contest Northwestern European Regionals (ETH, Live Archive) while the PDF says Western European Regional.

sources.evidence: Every page is headed 'ACM Scholastic Programming Contest, November 15, 1992 - Western European Regional' and the problems run from A to H.
The index page is headed 'Northwestern European Regionals 1992' and links eight files nwec92a to nwec92h.
The ICPC Live Archive category 'Regionals 1992 :: Europe - Northwestern' lists the same eight problem names as the PDF.

werc-1994.notes: Source 2 and 3 are index pages only; their problem files are not in our copy. The archives call the contest Northwestern European Regionals, the personal page Western European.

sources.evidence: The page is headed '1994 Western European Regionals of the ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest' and links problems A to H by name.
The index page is headed 'Northwestern European Regionals 1994' and links eight files nwec94a to nwec94h.
